concept: Noticing when someone else feels sad or hurt, and caring about it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices someone else is sad and stops to check on them
exercise.reflection_prompt: How did the character know something was wrong? What did they do about it?
exercise.practice: Student names a time they noticed someone else feeling sad and what they did

assessment.success_marker: student names a real or imagined noticing and response, not just 'I would help'
